autonomy_horizon: One backend persistence foundation slice. Add Candidate Review durable batch domain/repository/database contract only. Do not add Admin routes, Web UI, job execution loop, Public Client API, related hierarchy application, provider endpoint breadth, audit/undo, or hidden background execution in this campaign.
auto_advance_rule: Run PGDBE-020 only. Stop before server Admin route or execution if schema/repository contract gates are not green.
checkpoints: after core batch/status/item types are introduced
after repository trait shape is explicit
after SQLite and PostgreSQL implementations agree
after contract tests prove idempotent commit, lookup, status transition, and per-item outcome update
stop_conditions: raw provider response or secret exposure

autonomy_horizon: Backend durable batch route and execution campaign after PGDBE-020 lands. Keep Web and Public Client API separate until backend semantics are stable.
auto_advance_rule: Continue from PGDBE-030 to PGDBE-040 only when create/status route tests and generated Admin contract pass.
checkpoints: after create/status routes are redaction-safe and no-write
after execution uses DurableJobRuntime and records per-item outcomes
stop_conditions: raw provider response or secret exposure
